query:
SELECT 
  a.claim_id,
  c.claim_number,
  c.document_processing_status,
  a.fraud_score,
  a.fraud_risk_level,
  a.created_at,
  CASE WHEN a.cost_intelligence_json IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as has_cost_json,
  CASE WHEN a.pipeline_run_summary IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as has_pipeline_json,
  CASE WHEN a.forensic_audit_validation_json IS NOT NULL THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as has_forensic_validation
FROM ai_assessments a
JOIN claims c ON c.id = a.claim_id
WHERE a.claim_id IN (5850001, 6060001)
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC;
